concepts.title: Counting to twenty
concepts.description: Count a group past five, and read the number that names how many

problems.prompt: Count them. Which one has the same number?
problems.explanation: Touch each thing once and say the next number. The last number you say is how many there are.
problems.hint: Touch each thing and count out loud, then start again at one for the next group.

problems.prompt: How many are there? Which group matches?
problems.explanation: Touch each thing once and say the next number. The last number you say is how many there are.
problems.hint: Touch each thing and count out loud, then start again at one for the next group.

problems.prompt: How many are there? Which group matches?
problems.explanation: Count the whole row of ten first, then carry on counting the ones left over. Ten and four more is fourteen.
problems.hint: Count the full row of ten, then count on for the rest.
